title: FleetPulse telemetry envelope v1
description: Kafka record value on topic fleetpulse.telemetry.v1. UTF-8 JSON, max 1024 bytes. Record key = device_id (UTF-8). Optional headers: traceparent, tracestate (W3C). Unknown top-level fields are rejected (dead-letter topic). The processor's validation must be at least as strict as every database constraint, so a record that passes can never fail an insert and block its partition: (1) JSON parsed with duplicate-key detection on; (2) every `pattern` is a full match (Java `matcher().matches()` or `\A...\z`; `$` alone accepts a trailing newline); (3) `format` keywords are enforced, not just annotations: `event_id` parses as a UUID, `event_time` parses as an RFC 3339 instant in [2000-01-01T00:00:00Z, 2100-01-01T00:00:00Z); (4) Kafka key bytes == device_id; (5) epoch <= record LogAppendTime + 24 h, so one forged record cannot push a device's epoch into the future and freeze it. Any failure goes to the dead-letter topic with a reason, never an exception.

event_id.description: Name-based UUID v3 = java.util.UUID.nameUUIDFromBytes(UTF-8 of "<seed>:<device_id>:<epoch>:<seq>"), lowercase. Assigned once at generation, reused on resend/dup/replay. The processor validates the format only, not the derivation.

device_id.description: Must equal the Kafka record key. Same pattern as the device.device_id CHECK.

epoch.description: Simulator boot epoch (Unix ms at boot unless SIM_EPOCH is set). Ordering key is (epoch, seq). A new epoch is greater than the old one. Also bounded by LogAppendTime + 24 h (see top-level description).

seq.description: Strictly increasing per (device_id, epoch), starts at 1.

event_time.description: Device clock, RFC 3339 UTC with ms, year 2000-2099. May be skewed on purpose (chaos). Display only; never used for ordering, liveness or hysteresis.

replay.description: true when sent from the device buffer after a disconnect or Kafka outage. Not part of event identity. Alerts opened from such a sample are flagged backfilled.

error_count.description: Errors in this sample interval (not cumulative).
